verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents an embedding SDK for putting the builder inside a SaaS app, with customization and automatic user provisioning. Its pricing page explicitly promises the flow builder and integrations 'inside your own product, under your own brand', and an embeddable MCP flow extends this to embedded users. missing for 10: detailed documentation of white-label branding and theming controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of the embedding.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers

citations.quote: You can use the SDK to embed and customize Activepieces in your SaaS
Put a flow builder, AI agents and 760+ integrations inside your own product, under your own brand.
This section provides an overview of how to embed the Activepieces builder in your application and automatically provision the user.
Your user clicks one **Authorize** button inside your app, and your backend gets a token it can use to run that user's automations through AI.
